notes.title: Hotfix 13.1
notes.content:
So despite the giant leap in hotfix numbers (I've changed it so they correlate to the build number), this is a fix for Save Game slots not showing when pressing load game.

As long as the save you started was on the last path (so after November 19th) you should be able to open saves again now. Thanks for letting us know.

Best,

Harry
Antler Studios

notes.title: Post Launch Thoughts
notes.content:
One Week Since Launch.. 
Firstly we wanted to thank you folks for playing the Prologue & giving us some amazingly kind feedback. Whether that's been reviews, posting on the Community Hub, reaching out over our socials or streaming the Prologue: we really damn appreciate it! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40524169/85fe3be112ebf43f01d3a562a2043143e300f629.png

Let's Talk About What We've Learnt
Lots of things (lol). As a small part-time team of three, this going public on Steam has been a huge deal for us & it's really helped inform/prepare us for full release too.  Not just in terms of how we need to up our marketing, but down to simple bits like securing water-tight QA too. Most of all, it's giving us great insight to design tweaks and feature requests going forward for full release. 

Here's our list so far! 

Platforming 
Tweaking Gravity Scale, Jump Height, Max Step Height, Waist-Height Jump, Smooth Cam, possibly lifting up from ledges (swimming in particular). We haven't tweaked platforming for well over a year so this feels overdue. 
Player Movement
As mentioned above, this kinda goes hand-in-hand with Platforming too. We noticed a lot of players via streams were wanting to Sprint, vault & lift up via ledges. We need to test this out & see whether it breaks the platforming experience or not, but we've heard ya. If you have strong thoughts on this in any case please let us know! 
Menu Options
In general, the whole menu screen for functional items could be improved. We know we need to add more options too, such as: key mapping, sound options (music, SFX, dialogue), &  invert axis (patch already done for this bad boy). Anything you feel like we're missing here, comment below! 
Hiding Hands On Screen
We hear ya. This should totally be an option for those who want a de-cluttered screen! 
Swimming
Slower acceleration for starters, then experimenting with other improvements via our 'Playground' (this is our map in Unreal where we just test the heck out of new mechanics & gameplay.  If any of you have some examples of first-person games where swimming feels good, please send them our way! 
L-P1N's Voice
Although our TTS was always placeholder, we were considering whether it would be good to have an amazon poly voice for L-P1N for the full game. Though some folks loved it, we thought the majority didn't! 
Level of Spoon Feeding Players
So far we think we're pretty much there in terms of how far we teach the player to do bits. However we did hear that other players just want to completely figure things out for themselves. We're considering adding difficulty modes for this so folks can play at their desired pace - this is a stretch goal for us right now though. 
People Wanting to Skip Tutorial Hoops
For the full game, we always intended the tutorial to be on the airship & much shorter than the current set up. We will add in a 'skip' option for this though, so whoever just wants to crack on can. 
Freeform Exploring Improvements
We try and make our world as open and free as we possibly can. There are loads of mini challenges throughout the game which we don't teach the player, so we reward the folks who do.. However, we realised that our way of rewarding folks wasn't very obvious too. We'll fix this next time by adding minicut scenes/vistas once it's completed, journal entries where appropriate, as well as reinforcing with Steam Achievements. 
Steam Achievements
Speaking of! We completely agree with you folks: Project Grove needs Steam Achievements. We were considering adding these for the Prologue too but in all honesty, we really wanted to set our focus on the full game and release the Prologue out to you folks as soon as we could!

Plus One Thing We Were Already Tweaking
Potion Crafting! We've wanted to tweak our potion crafting for a little while now & already scheduled development time for this pre-Prologue launch. We really want to refactor some of the logic behind crafting which will impact the flow too. It will (largely) still be the same experience, but we hope going forward there will be a little bit more understanding to why you're doing certain actions.

Anything We've Missed? Let Us Know, Comment Below!
..And that was just to name a few! If you feel like we've missed anything or there's other areas of our game you think we should address, please comment below & let us know! We'd love to hear your thoughts on this, cus it's you folks who are shaping Project Grove now & in months to come!

Love, 
STAG x

notes.title: Hotfix 10.4
notes.content: Some users have reported the winch not working properly when loading a save inside the airship. I've added a lever next to it which can be used to call the winch up.

notes.title: Hotfix 10.3
notes.content: Afternoon everyone, I've just pushed a hotfix which should prevent the crash occurring when interacting with the bed/faxophone. The 'actual' issue still isn't fixed but in short the bug is caused by not having a potion equipped, so for now you can no longer unequipped the potion :sweat_smile:  If you are loading a save where you didn't have the Bubblate potion equipped, please do so before interacting with offending bed/machine.
